verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules (hooks) are a fair axis for an AI coding workbench, but the evidence pack never documents user-defined rules that fire actions on events. Goal management covers planning and execution, and remote invocation via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram is manually triggered by the user; both are adjacent features, not event-rule automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
